docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Jacob’s free English translation of Daṇḍin’s Daśakumāracarita, the adventures of ten princes, a picaresque romance of the Sanskrit tradition (London, 1873). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Hindoo tales; or, The adventures of ten princes; freely translated from the Sanscrit of the Dasakumaracharitam · Dandin, 7th cent, Jacob, Philip Whittington, 1805-1889 · 1873, 400 scanned pages. Published 1873; Philip Whittington Jacob died 1889; the text is of the seventh century; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
